	_ "github.com/xtls/xray-core/app/proxyman/outbound"

func controlMode(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	mode := os.Getenv("XRAY_CONTROL_MODE")
	if mode != "official" && mode != "off" && mode != "on" {
		t.Fatalf("CONTROL_META invalid mode=%q", mode)
	}
	return mode
}

func controlCount(t *testing.T, name string, fallback, maximum int) int {
	t.Helper()
	value := os.Getenv(name)
	if value == "" {
		return fallback
	}
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
	if err != nil || n < 1 || n > maximum {
		t.Fatalf("CONTROL_META invalid %s=%q, permitted 1..%d", name, value, maximum)
	}
	return n
}

func nilValue(value reflect.Value) bool {
	switch value.Kind() {
	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Pointer, reflect.Slice:
		return value.IsNil()
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func checkInspection(t *testing.T, manager any, mode string) {
	t.Helper()
	value := reflect.ValueOf(manager)
	enable := value.MethodByName("EnableInspection")
	observation := value.MethodByName("Observation")
	if mode == "official" {
		t.Logf("CONTROL_META mode=%s enable-method=%t observation-method=%t", mode, enable.IsValid(), observation.IsValid())
		return
	}
	if !enable.IsValid() || !observation.IsValid() || enable.Type().NumIn() != 1 || enable.Type().NumOut() != 2 || observation.Type().NumIn() != 0 || observation.Type().NumOut() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("CONTROL_META mode=%s fork inspection signature absent", mode)
	}
	if mode == "on" {
		result := enable.Call([]reflect.Value{reflect.Zero(enable.Type().In(0))})
		if !nilValue(result[1]) || nilValue(result[0]) {
			t.Fatalf("CONTROL_META mode=on EnableInspection result=%v error=%v", result[0], result[1])
		}
	}
	state := observation.Call(nil)[0]
	wantPresent := mode == "on"
	if nilValue(state) == wantPresent {
		t.Fatalf("CONTROL_META mode=%s observation-present=%t want=%t", mode, !nilValue(state), wantPresent)
	}
	t.Logf("CONTROL_META mode=%s enable-method=true observation-present=%t", mode, !nilValue(state))
}

type echoOwner struct {
	conn *net.UDPConn
	done chan struct{}
	mask byte
}

func startEcho(t *testing.T, mask byte) (*echoOwner, cnet.Destination) {
	t.Helper()
	conn, err := net.ListenUDP("udp4", &net.UDPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1)})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	owner := &echoOwner{conn: conn, done: make(chan struct{}), mask: mask}
	go func() {
		defer close(owner.done)
		packet := make([]byte, 8192)
		for {
			n, peer, err := conn.ReadFromUDP(packet)
			if os.Getenv("XRAY_CONTROL_ATTRIBUTION") == "1" {
				t.Logf("CONTROL_TRACE echo-read local=%v peer=%v n=%d err=%v", conn.LocalAddr(), peer, n, err)
			}
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			response := append([]byte(nil), packet[:n]...)
			for i := range response {
				response[i] ^= mask
			}
			written, writeErr := conn.WriteToUDP(response, peer)
			if os.Getenv("XRAY_CONTROL_ATTRIBUTION") == "1" {
				t.Logf("CONTROL_TRACE echo-write local=%v peer=%v n=%d err=%v", conn.LocalAddr(), peer, written, writeErr)
			}
		}
	}()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		_ = conn.Close()
		select {
		case <-owner.done:
		case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
			t.Error("CONTROL_ECHO worker did not stop")
		}
	})
	port := conn.LocalAddr().(*net.UDPAddr).Port
	return owner, cnet.UDPDestination(cnet.LocalHostIP, cnet.Port(port))
}

func freeTCPPort(t *testing.T) int {
	t.Helper()
	listener, err := net.ListenTCP("tcp4", &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1)})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	port := listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port
	_ = listener.Close()
	return port
}

func startCore(t *testing.T, mode string) (string, *core.Instance) {
	t.Helper()
	port := freeTCPPort(t)
	instance, err := core.New(&core.Config{
		App: []*serial.TypedMessage{
			serial.ToTypedMessage(&appstats.Config{}),
			serial.ToTypedMessage(&proxyman.InboundConfig{}),
			serial.ToTypedMessage(&proxyman.OutboundConfig{}),
			serial.ToTypedMessage(&dispatcher.Config{}),
		},
		Outbound: []*core.OutboundHandlerConfig{{Tag: "control-direct", ProxySettings: serial.ToTypedMessage(&freedom.Config{})}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := instance.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("CONTROL_CORE close: %v", err)
		}
	})
	manager := instance.GetFeature(fs.ManagerType())
	if manager == nil {
		t.Fatal("CONTROL_META stats manager absent")
	}
	checkInspection(t, manager, mode)
	if err := core.AddInboundHandler(instance, &core.InboundHandlerConfig{
		Tag: "control-socks",
		ReceiverSettings: serial.ToTypedMessage(&proxyman.ReceiverConfig{
			Listen:   cnet.NewIPOrDomain(cnet.LocalHostIP),
			PortList: &cnet.PortList{Range: []*cnet.PortRange{cnet.SinglePortRange(cnet.Port(port))}},
		}),
		ProxySettings: serial.ToTypedMessage(&socks.ServerConfig{AuthType: socks.AuthType_NO_AUTH, UdpEnabled: true}),
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := instance.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if mode != "official" {
		state := reflect.ValueOf(manager).MethodByName("Observation").Call(nil)[0]
		if nilValue(state) == (mode == "on") {
			t.Fatalf("CONTROL_META post-start mode=%s observation-present=%t", mode, !nilValue(state))
		}
	}
	return net.JoinHostPort("127.0.0.1", strconv.Itoa(port)), instance
}

type association struct {
	control net.Conn
	client  *net.UDPConn
	relay   *net.UDPAddr
}

func openAssociation(address string) (*association, error) {
	control, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp", address, 3*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	_ = control.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second))
	response, err := socks.ClientHandshake(&protocol.RequestHeader{Command: protocol.RequestCommandUDP}, control, control)
	if err != nil {
		_ = control.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	_ = control.SetDeadline(time.Time{})
	client, err := net.ListenUDP("udp4", &net.UDPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1)})
	if err != nil {
		_ = control.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	return &association{control: control, client: client, relay: &net.UDPAddr{IP: response.Address.IP(), Port: int(response.Port)}}, nil
}

func (a *association) Close() {
	_ = a.client.Close()
	_ = a.control.Close()
}

func (a *association) exchange(mode string, iteration int, dest cnet.Destination, payload []byte, mask byte) error {
	request, err := socks.EncodeUDPPacket(&protocol.RequestHeader{Address: dest.Address, Port: dest.Port}, payload)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("CONTROL_PACKET encode mode=%s iteration=%d dest=%v: %w", mode, iteration, dest, err)
	}
	defer request.Release()
	_ = a.client.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second))
	if _, err := a.client.WriteToUDP(request.Bytes(), a.relay); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("CONTROL_PACKET send mode=%s iteration=%d local=%v relay=%v dest=%v: %w", mode, iteration, a.client.LocalAddr(), a.relay, dest, err)
	}
	if os.Getenv("XRAY_CONTROL_ATTRIBUTION") == "1" {
		fmt.Printf("CONTROL_TRACE client-send iteration=%d local=%v relay=%v dest=%v\n", iteration, a.client.LocalAddr(), a.relay, dest)
	}
	response := buf.New()
	defer response.Release()
	n, sender, err := a.client.ReadFromUDP(response.Extend(buf.Size))
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("CONTROL_PACKET receive mode=%s iteration=%d n=%d sender=%v local=%v relay=%v dest=%v: %w", mode, iteration, n, sender, a.client.LocalAddr(), a.relay, dest, err)
	}
	response.Resize(0, int32(n))
	wire := append([]byte(nil), response.Bytes()[:min(n, 16)]...)
	header, err := socks.DecodeUDPPacket(response)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("CONTROL_PACKET decode mode=%s iteration=%d n=%d sender=%v local=%v relay=%v dest=%v wire=%x: %w", mode, iteration, n, sender, a.client.LocalAddr(), a.relay, dest, wire, err)
	}
	want := append([]byte(nil), payload...)
	for i := range want {
		want[i] ^= mask
	}
	if header.Destination() != dest || !bytes.Equal(response.Bytes(), want) {
		return fmt.Errorf("CONTROL_PACKET mismatch mode=%s iteration=%d n=%d sender=%v local=%v relay=%v dest=%v decoded=%v wire=%x got=%x want=%x", mode, iteration, n, sender, a.client.LocalAddr(), a.relay, dest, header.Destination(), wire, response.Bytes(), want)
	}
	return nil
}

func TestControlSOCKSUDP(t *testing.T) {
	mode := controlMode(t)
	iterations := controlCount(t, "XRAY_CONTROL_ITERATIONS", 20, 64)
	_, first := startEcho(t, 0x19)
	_, second := startEcho(t, 0x37)
	address, _ := startCore(t, mode)
	firstAssociation, err := openAssociation(address)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := firstAssociation.exchange(mode, -1, first, []byte("first destination"), 0x19); err != nil {
		firstAssociation.Close()
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := firstAssociation.exchange(mode, -1, second, []byte("second destination"), 0x37); err != nil {
		firstAssociation.Close()
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	firstAssociation.Close()
	jobs := make(chan int)
	results := make(chan error, iterations)
	var workers sync.WaitGroup
	for worker := 0; worker < 4; worker++ {
		workers.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer workers.Done()
			for iteration := range jobs {
				a, err := openAssociation(address)
				if err == nil {
					payload := []byte(fmt.Sprintf("association-%d", iteration))
					err = a.exchange(mode, iteration, first, payload, 0x19)
					if err == nil {
						err = a.exchange(mode, iteration, second, payload, 0x37)
					}
					a.Close()
				}
				results <- err
			}
		}()
	}
	for i := 0; i < iterations; i++ {
		jobs <- i
	}
	close(jobs)
	workers.Wait()
	close(results)
	for err := range results {
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}
	t.Logf("CONTROL_META mode=%s associations=%d destinations=2 workers=4", mode, iterations+1)
}

func TestControlUDPPortAllocation(t *testing.T) {
	mode := controlMode(t)
	count := controlCount(t, "XRAY_CONTROL_PORTS", 256, 512)
	var system, standard []net.PacketConn
	defer func() {
		// Keep exact tuples even after an early assertion, before releasing the
		// sockets. Other test binaries may hold wildcard sockets on these ports.
		for name, sockets := range map[string][]net.PacketConn{"system": system, "standard": standard} {
			tuples := make([]string, 0, len(sockets))
			for _, conn := range sockets {
				tuples = append(tuples, conn.LocalAddr().Network()+":"+conn.LocalAddr().String())
			}
			t.Logf("CONTROL_PORT_BINDINGS mode=%s kind=%s tuples=%v", mode, name, tuples)
		}
		for _, conn := range standard {
			_ = conn.Close()
		}
		for _, conn := range system {
			_ = conn.Close()
		}
	}()
	seenSystem, seenStandard := make(map[string]int), make(map[string]int)
	systemPorts, standardPorts := make(map[int]string), make(map[int]string)
	for i := 0; i < count; i++ {
		conn, err := internet.ListenSystemPacket(context.Background(), &net.UDPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1)}, nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("CONTROL_PORT mode=%s system index=%d held=%d err=%v", mode, i, len(system), err)
		}
		system = append(system, conn)
		tuple := conn.LocalAddr().Network() + ":" + conn.LocalAddr().String()
		if earlier, exists := seenSystem[tuple]; exists {
			t.Fatalf("CONTROL_PORT duplicate system tuple=%s first=%d second=%d", tuple, earlier, i)
		}
		seenSystem[tuple] = i
		port := conn.LocalAddr().(*net.UDPAddr).Port
		if earlier, exists := systemPorts[port]; exists && earlier != tuple {
			t.Logf("CONTROL_PORT same-port distinct-system-bind port=%d earlier=%s current=%s", port, earlier, tuple)
		}
		systemPorts[port] = tuple
		plain, err := net.ListenUDP("udp4", &net.UDPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1)})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("CONTROL_PORT mode=%s standard index=%d held=%d err=%v", mode, i, len(standard), err)
		}
		standard = append(standard, plain)
		plainTuple := plain.LocalAddr().Network() + ":" + plain.LocalAddr().String()
		if earlier, exists := seenStandard[plainTuple]; exists {
			t.Fatalf("CONTROL_PORT duplicate standard tuple=%s first=%d second=%d", plainTuple, earlier, i)
		}
		seenStandard[plainTuple] = i
		plainPort := plain.LocalAddr().(*net.UDPAddr).Port
		if earlier, exists := standardPorts[plainPort]; exists && earlier != plainTuple {
			t.Logf("CONTROL_PORT same-port distinct-standard-bind port=%d earlier=%s current=%s", plainPort, earlier, plainTuple)
		}
		standardPorts[plainPort] = plainTuple
		if prior, exists := systemPorts[plainPort]; exists {
			t.Logf("CONTROL_PORT cross-cohort-port-overlap port=%d system=%s standard=%s", plainPort, prior, plainTuple)
		}
	}
	t.Logf("CONTROL_PORT mode=%s held-system=%d held-standard=%d unique-system=%d unique-standard=%d", mode, len(system), len(standard), len(seenSystem), len(seenStandard))
}
